{{Quote|One minute you're living life as normal and the next debris is raining down from hyperspace. Hospitals are overrun from here to Vjun, if they exist at all.|[[Okana]]|<ref name="First Duty">{{InsiderCite|issue1=201|issue2=202|Starlight: First Duty}}</ref>}}
'''Vjun''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Updated and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] in grid square Q-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> situated between [[Lucazec]] and [[Phindar]] along the [[Salin Corridor]] [[hyperspace route]].<ref name="RO planets" /> In the wake of the [[Emergences]] of the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]] during the [[High Republic Era]], Vjun was among many locations in the Outer Rim whose [[Medcenter|hospitals]] were overrun with victims.<ref name="First Duty" /> It was home to the famous [[tailor]]s who wove [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s elegant [[cloak]].<ref name="Updated and Expanded" /> At some point, Dooku [[Duel on Vjun (Dooku)|dueled]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] on the planet, and before making a tactical withdrawal, he accomplished the nearly impossible by wounding his former Master.<ref name= "LJE English">{{EncyclopediaCite|Lightsabers and Jedi Equipment}} (English version)</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Vjun was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'', a [[2014]] reference book written by [[Adam Bray]], [[Kerrie Dougherty]], [[Cole Horton]], and [[Michael Kogge]].<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> It was originally created for the [[1995]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] comic [[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]], written by [[Tom Veitch]] and pencilled by [[Cam Kennedy]].<ref name="Hand of Darkness">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref>
